title: Agentic Behavior Engineering: A Design-by-Contract Methodology for Specifying, Verifying, and Governing Enterprise AI Agents
title_zh: 智能体行为工程：用于规约、验证与治理企业AI智能体的契约式设计方法论

paragraphs.en: 提出智能体行为工程方法，将智能体可观察行为作为版本控制产物，用契约式设计规约、验证与治理企业AI智能体。 Enterprise teams that deploy large language model (LLM) agents inherit a maintenance problem that traditional testing does not address. The model is non-deterministic, but the larger risk is that most of what changes an agent's behavior (a retired model version, a revised policy, an upstream schema change, a prompt edit meant to fix one case) originates outside the owning team and is discovered as a production defect rather than caught as a regression. This paper presents Agentic Behavior Engineering (ABE), a platform-agnostic methodology that treats observable agent behavior, rather than the prompt or the model, as the version-controlled engineering artifact. ABE adapts Design by Contract to non-deterministic systems. A specification-only behavior contract with stable rule identifiers states what the agent must do, must not do, and when it must abstain for lack of evidence; a lightweight scenario library turns each rule into concrete situations; and every engineering artifact (tests, runtime policies, telemetry) references the contract in one direction only, so that specification and implementation can change independently without drifting apart. The method organizes the work into five responsibilities (Specify, Ground, Control, Verify, Observe), treats missing evidence and a verified negative as different things, enforces authority outside the model, gates releases on per-scenario pass^k reliability rather than aggregate accuracy, and classifies every production run against the contract so that each finding routes to the asset that must change. We illustrate the method with an executable capacity-allocation boundary suite and a constructed worked example of a product-review approval workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 提出智能体行为工程方法，将智能体可观察行为作为版本控制产物，用契约式设计规约、验证与治理企业AI智能体。部署大语言模型（LLM）智能体的企业团队会面临一个传统测试无法解决的维护难题。 模型是非确定性的，但更大的风险在于，改变智能体行为的多数因素（被弃用的模型版本、修订后的策略、上游模式变更、为修复某一案例而做的提示词编辑）都源自负责团队之外，并且往往是作为生产缺陷被发现，而非作为回归问题被捕获。 本文提出智能体行为工程（ABE），这是一种平台无关的方法论，它将可观察的智能体行为而非提示词或模型视为受版本控制的工程产物。 ABE 将契约式设计适配到非确定性系统中。 仅包含规约的行为契约以稳定的规则标识符声明智能体必须做什么、不得做什么，以及在缺乏证据时必须弃权；轻量级场景库将每条规则转化为具体情境；每个工程产物（测试、运行时策略、遥测）只单向引用契约，从而使规约与实现可以独立变更而不会彼此偏离。 该方法将工作组织为五项职责（规约、扎根、控制、验证、观察），将证据缺失与已验证的否定结果区分开来，在模型之外强制权威，以逐场景的 pass^k 可靠性而非总体准确率作为发布门槛，并将每次生产运行对照契约分类，使每个发现都能路由到必须变更的资产上。 我们通过一个可执行的容量分配边界套件和一个构建的产品评审审批工作流实例来阐释该方法。
